title: [3.1.0.3] Loop stuck on basal rate despite instance of low BG. Pump unreachable issue?
symptom: Loop was stuck on basal rate for ~5 hours despite low BG of 62, with no SMBs or rate changes. A pump unreachable error was signaled at 9:30, and normal behavior returned after restarting AAPS. The issue recurred later with the app stuck on an SMB request and pump stuck on basal rate since ~6:30 AM.
cause: The thread suggests the issue is related to unreliable Bluetooth connection between AAPS and the pump, possibly due to the phone (Realme 8). The user notes that restarting AAPS immediately reconnects the pump, and the problem stopped after switching phones.
fix: Restarting AAPS (exiting and restarting the app) immediately reconnects the pump and resolves the issue. The user also suggests that switching to a different phone resolved the problem.
evidence_quote: I'll close this. I think the main problem was with unreliable BT connection with that phone (Realme 8). Since I moved to another phone this hasn't recurred significantly...
